test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes of the Government of India supports students belonging to minority communities clearing prelims conducted by UPSC/SSC, State Public Service Commission (PSC), etc?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nai Udaan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nai Udaan is a scheme launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India, to support minority students in clearing competitive exams like UPSC/SSC, State PSC, etc.**
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance for coaching, study material, and other expenses related to the exam preparation.
 
• The scheme also offers soft skills training, remedial coaching, and mentoring support to help students improve their performance in the exams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maulana Azad National Fellowship is a scholarship scheme for minority students pursuing higher education such as MPhil/PhD.**

 
 
• Candidates from underprivileged backgrounds who have completed their post-graduation coursework with at least 50% of the required subjects and who choose to work on their research full-time without applying for a UGC-NET or UGC-CSIR NET JRF are eligible.
 
 
 
• **Nai Manzil is a skill development and livelihood generation program for school dropouts and unemployed youth from minority communities.**
 
 
• It was introduced on August 8, 2015.
 
 
 
• **Naya Savera is a scheme for providing interest-free loans to minority students for pursuing higher education.**
 
 
• It was initiated on July 17th, 2007.
